$comment: Golden vectors asserted by BOTH gpu/tests/golden_vectors.rs and
gpu/js/parity.test.mjs. Neither side owns these numbers, so a drift in
either is caught and a change has to be made here deliberately.
Patterns are the helpers in gpu/src/cpu.rs tests: checker fills 20 and
230 in size-pixel cells; solid fills one value.
The pHash values depend on gpu/testdata/dct-cos-8x32.json. They are
bit-identical across the two languages only because that table is
shared: V8 bundles its own fdlibm for Math.cos, and computing the
cosines on each side made the two disagree on 3 of 64 bits here.
